title: MailXaminer HTML Report
description: MailXaminer HTML Report is a program that generates an index page to view emails exported in HTML.

slide1.title: MailXaminer HTML Report Graphical Interface
slide1.description: The program shows the folder structure before generating the report

slide2.title: Original Structure
slide2.description: Folder structure generated by MailXaminer, the program will recognize the structure and generate the appropriate links

slide3.title: Report Interface
slide3.description: Report graphical interface, on the left folder selection. At the top emails, at the bottom the selected email.

content.intro: Starting from an HTML report generated by the forensic software
content.generate: allows you to generate an index HTML file.
content.description: This file allows you to view in a web page, divided into 3 sections, all the emails in the generated report.
content.layout: On the left the subfolders, on the right at the top the list of emails that the selected folder contains, and at the bottom the selected email.
content.filters: Additionally, it is possible to apply filters to the email list.
